title: SLECI-analysis: reproducible analysis code for neuropsychiatric involvement and acute kidney injury in critically ill patients with systemic lupus erythematosus
description: Analysis code (SQL extraction + Python pipeline, with R code for the time-varying Cox models) for the study 'Cognitive/Neuropsychiatric Involvement and Acute Kidney Injury in Critically Ill Patients With Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: A Derivation and External Consistency Study'. Cohorts are derived from PhysioNet-credentialed databases (MIMIC-IV derivation, eICU-CRD external consistency analysis, NWICU descriptive corroboration only). Repository contains code only; no patient-level data are published (PhysioNet Data Use Agreement).
